panels.name: cell_expression_dotplot
panels.caption: Dot area is the nonzero fraction; color is mean stored log-normalized expression. First 20 declared variable genes (or genes if flags absent). This is descriptive, not a differential marker test.

panels.name: evidence_heatmap
panels.caption: Direction is defined by the declared orientation. Per-layer p values include feature-to-gene aggregation; color is descriptive and does not identify individually significant layers.

panels.name: combined_ranking
panels.caption: Orange marks selected genes; point area increases with measured layer count. Untestable rows have no point. Ranking uses raw joint p; the horizontal scale uses BY q.

panels.name: concordance
panels.caption: Counts include all declared genes, without a significance filter. Same direction is not independent replication. Neutral denotes tied directional evidence; not-both includes unmeasured/untestable genes.

panels.name: measurement_patterns
panels.caption: Exclusive measurement patterns preserve the distinction between absence of evidence and evidence of no association. The TSV contains every observed pattern.

panels.name: rank_sensitivity
panels.caption: Each column removes one assay and holds r fixed. Average ranks handle ties within the same common testable gene set. Positive values indicate a better rank with that assay. This is sensitivity of supplied evidence, not measured predictive gain; eligibility losses are recorded separately.

panels.name: pathway_evidence
panels.caption: Top 25 by joint p when enabled, otherwise by minimum layer p for display only. Unsigned enrichment is plotted positive regardless of mechanism. All raw p and descriptive scores remain in the TSV.

panels.name: pathway_coverage
panels.caption: Gene coverage uses the assay-specific measured background. A large overlap does not itself establish enrichment.

panels.name: shared_gene_support
panels.caption: Genes supplied by upstream analyses, such as leading-edge genes or ORA hits, are counted once per pathway. Empty contributions mean the upstream test did not supply gene-level support.

panels.name: pathway_overlap
panels.caption: Edges join pathways with full-GMT gene-set Jaccard overlap >= 0.25. This shows annotation redundancy, not molecular interactions or independent biological confirmations.

panels.name: pathway_ranking
panels.caption: Point area encodes -log10(FDR q), capped at 16; position and color encode NES. Negative NES means enrichment toward the negative end of the supplied ranking.

panels.name: leading_edge
panels.caption: Blue indicates leading-edge membership; white is absence from that leading edge, not a negative gene effect. The TSV includes all leading-edge genes in the displayed pathways.
